items: 【The Latest Android 15 Tablet】 The android tablet runs on the latest version of the android 15.0 operating system. It offers a user-friendly interface and access to a wide range of apps from the Google Play Store, such as Netflix, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Disney+, etc.

【18GB RAM+128GB ROM+2TB Expand】 This 10.1 inch android 15 tablet is equipped with 18GB RAM ( Contain 14GB Expanded Memory) for smooth multitasking and efficient performance. It also has 128GB ROM storage for storing your apps, files, and media. Micro SD card slot provides up to 2TB of expandable memory, giving you unlimited options.

【2.4G/5G WiFi 6+6000mAh】 Our android tablet lets you enjoy lightning-fast Internet speeds with 5G WiFi connectivity. It makes it easy to stay connected on the go, providing a more convenient experience for entertainment, browsing, gaming and shopping. It also comes with an 6000mAh battery that lasts up to 10 hours on a single charge, perfect for long-distance commuting and travel.

【Portable 2 in 1 Tablet】 The 10 inch tablet has a professional work mode. With a keyboard and mouse that allows you to seamlessly switch between tablet and laptop mode. The tablet case ensures the tablet stays safe from scratches and bumps. It is an ideal device whether it is for work, study or play, Good gift for colleagues, students, writers, and business people.
